hypothesis: Startup overhead is conditional rather than linear in module count or dictionary capacity. Separate indicators for fresh dictionary storage and empty admissions before runtime initialization should explain the two large early costs while retaining the main allocation-versus-decoding distinction.

pcvs.name: initial_allocation
pcvs.rationale: Separates initial block allocation from incremental decoding.

pcvs.name: fresh_request_table
pcvs.rationale: Identifies the observed minimal dictionary capacity before its first insertion, capturing first-use initialization costs.

pcvs.name: cold_empty_admission
pcvs.rationale: Identifies empty-table admissions before the observed runtime module-loading transition, separating the two expensive startup calls from later admissions.

pcvs.name: active_request_tables
pcvs.rationale: Captures occupancy-dependent bookkeeping and preserves distinct states within steady execution.
